<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#030305">
<meta name="description" content="ZentauriX — archivos paranormales, OVNIs, fantasmas, conspiraciones, anomalías y misterios sin resolver.">
<title>ZentauriX — Archivos Inexplicables</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Orbitron:wght@500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#020205;--panel:#08090d;--panel2:#0d1016;--red:#d4082f;--red2:#ff1745;
  --cyan:#19d9ff;--violet:#8c5cff;--ice:#e8eef4;--muted:#8c949f;
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.09);--heading:'Orbitron',sans-serif;--body:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;
  --shadow:0 24px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.65);--radius:4px
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;background:var(--bg)}
body{background:
radial-gradient(circle at 20% 0%,rgba(25,217,255,.08),transparent 28%),
radial-gradient(circle at 90% 18%,rgba(212,8,47,.10),transparent 25%),
linear-gradient(180deg,#020205 0%,#05060a 50%,#020205 100%);
color:var(--ice);font-family:var(--body);font-size:18px;line-height:1.5;overflow-x:hidden}
body:before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;opacity:.045;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 180 180' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='.5'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}button,input,textarea,select{font:inherit}
.container{width:min(1200px,calc(100% - 40px));margin:auto}
.nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:1000;height:80px;background:rgba(2,2,5,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(212,8,47,.25)}
.nav .inner{width:min(1320px,calc(100% - 30px));height:100%;margin:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:22px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:205px}.brand img{width:50px;height:50px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 13px rgba(212,8,47,.35))}
.brand strong{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:18px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#fff}.brand small{display:block;color:#8e969f;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:3px}
.links{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:center}.links a{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.2px;color:#aeb5be;padding:30px 0;position:relative}
.links a:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:100%;bottom:19px;height:2px;background:var(--red);transition:.3s}.links a:hover,.links a.active{color:#fff}.links a:hover:after,.links a.active:after{right:0}
.yt,.btn-red{background:var(--red);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(212,8,47,.2)}.yt{padding:11px 15px;border-radius:3px;font-family:var(--heading);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px}
.menu{display:none;background:none;border:0;color:#fff;font-size:25px}

.hero{min-height:820px;display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;padding:130px 20px 80px;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden}
.hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-3;background-image:linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(3,3,7,.93) 0%,rgba(3,5,9,.55) 48%,rgba(3,3,7,.82) 100%),url('data:image/svg+xml;base64,');background-size:cover;background-position:center;background-blend-mode:normal}
.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;opacity:.65;background:
linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px),
linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:70px 70px;
mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,black,transparent 85%)}
.hero-art{position:absolute;right:-4%;top:18%;width:min(720px,62vw);aspect-ratio:1;z-index:-1;opacity:.85}
.orb{position:absolute;inset:17%;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(25,217,255,.35);box-shadow:0 0 90px rgba(25,217,255,.08),inset 0 0 90px rgba(140,92,255,.08)}
.orb:before,.orb:after{content:"";position:absolute;border-radius:50%;inset:12%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);transform:rotate(30deg) scaleX(1.5)}
.orb:after{transform:rotate(-55deg) scaleX(1.5);border-color:rgba(212,8,47,.25)}
.beam{position:absolute;width:130%;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(25,217,255,.8),transparent);top:50%;left:-15%;transform:rotate(-18deg);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(25,217,255,.55)}
.scan{position:absolute;inset:10%;border:1px dashed rgba(25,217,255,.12);border-radius:50%;animation:spin 18s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.hero-content{position:relative}.kicker{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--heading);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2.5px;color:#a7b0ba}.kicker i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red2);box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--red2);animation:pulse 1.5s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{50%{opacity:.3;transform:scale(.7)}}
.hero h1{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:clamp(42px,6.5vw,86px);line-height:.97;max-width:900px;margin:20px 0 20px;letter-spacing:-2.5px;text-shadow:0 5px 35px #000}
.hero h1 span{color:var(--red2);text-shadow:0 0 35px rgba(255,23,63,.3)}
.hero p{max-width:700px;color:#d2d7dd;font-size:21px;line-height:1.35;text-shadow:0 2px 16px #000}
.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:30px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid transparent;padding:12px 18px;font-family:var(--heading);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}.btn-red:hover{background:#ef123d}.btn-ghost{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.22);background:rgba(0,0,0,.28);color:#fff;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--cyan);color:var(--cyan)}
.scroll{position:absolute;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-family:var(--heading);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:3px;color:#737c86}.scroll:after{content:"";display:block;width:1px;height:35px;background:linear-gradient(var(--red),transparent);margin:8px auto 0}
.ticker{border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:#07080b;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;cursor:default}.ticker-track{display:inline-flex;gap:42px;padding:12px 0;min-width:100%;animation:marquee 38s linear infinite}.ticker:hover .ticker-track,.ticker:focus-within .ticker-track{animation-play-state:paused}.ticker span,.ticker a{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#9aa1aa;transition:.2s}.ticker a{cursor:pointer}.ticker a:hover,.ticker a:focus-visible{color:var(--cyan);text-decoration:underline}.ticker b{color:var(--red2)}@keyframes marquee{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

.section{padding:105px 0;position:relative}.section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:25px;margin-bottom:35px}.eyebrow{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--red2);margin-bottom:8px}.section h2{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:clamp(26px,3vw,40px);line-height:1.08;color:#fff}.section-head p{max-width:510px;color:#929aa4}
.archive{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}.card{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#101218,#07080b);border:1px solid var(--line);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:.4s}.card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:rgba(212,8,47,.62);box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.75),0 0 35px rgba(212,8,47,.08)}
.card-img{height:225px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:
radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%,rgba(255,255,255,.13) 0 3%,transparent 4%),
radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%,rgba(25,217,255,.18),transparent 24%),
linear-gradient(145deg,#07080d,#17131a 48%,#050508)}
.card:nth-child(2) .card-img{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 52% 48%,rgba(255,255,255,.55) 0 1%,transparent 2%),linear-gradient(130deg,#020306,#17101a 45%,#020306)}
.card:nth-child(3) .card-img{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 48% 45%,rgba(140,92,255,.25),transparent 15%),linear-gradient(115deg,#08080c,#151119 50%,#030306)}
.card-img:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 35%,rgba(0,0,0,.88));}.card[data-cat="ovni"] .card-img{background-image:url('data:image/svg+xml;base64,');background-size:cover;background-position:center}.card[data-cat="anomalia"] .card-img{background-image:url('data:image/svg+xml;base64,');background-size:cover;background-position:center}.card[data-cat="fantasma"] .card-img{background-image:url('data:image/svg+xml;base64,');background-size:cover;background-position:center}.card[data-cat="conspiracion"] .card-img{background-image:url('data:image/svg+xml;base64,');background-size:cover;background-position:center}.tag{position:absolute;z-index:2;top:12px;left:12px;background:rgba(3,3,5,.78);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);padding:6px 8px;font-family:var(--heading);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#cfd7df}
.card-body{padding:21px}.case-no{color:#666e78;font-family:var(--heading);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2px}.card h3{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:19px;line-height:1.2;margin:8px 0 10px;color:#fff}.card p{color:#8f969f;font-size:16px}.card-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:18px;padding-top:15px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.verdict{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:8px;color:var(--cyan);letter-spacing:1px}

.categories{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:22px}.category{min-height:185px;padding:22px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035),rgba(255,255,255,.01));position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:.3s}.category:hover{border-color:rgba(25,217,255,.4);transform:translateY(-5px)}.category .icon{font-size:32px;margin-bottom:20px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(25,217,255,.25))}.category h3{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:15px;margin-bottom:6px}.category p{color:#7e8791;font-size:14px}.category .count{position:absolute;right:14px;top:14px;font-family:var(--heading);font-size:8px;color:#555e68;letter-spacing:1px}

.feature{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#06070a,#0b1117 55%,#06070a);border-block:1px solid var(--line);padding:90px 0}.feature-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.02fr .98fr;gap:55px;align-items:center}
.feature-media{position:relative;border:1px solid rgba(25,217,255,.18);padding:10px;background:#050508;box-shadow:var(--shadow);min-height:390px;overflow:hidden}.feature-visual{height:100%;min-height:368px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 44%,rgba(25,217,255,.28),transparent 10%),radial-gradient(circle at 50% 44%,rgba(25,217,255,.10),transparent 35%),url('data:image/svg+xml;base64,') center/cover,linear-gradient(160deg,#030409,#111622 52%,#050508);background-size:auto,auto,cover,cover;position:relative}.feature-visual:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:12%;right:12%;top:47%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--cyan),transparent);box-shadow:0 0 20px var(--cyan);transform:rotate(-12deg)}.feature-visual:after{content:"UNKNOWN / SIGNAL";position:absolute;bottom:20px;left:20px;font-family:var(--heading);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:3px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
.feature-copy h2{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,48px);line-height:1.05;margin:8px 0 18px}.feature-copy h2 span{color:var(--red2)}.feature-copy p{color:#9ca3ab;max-width:570px;font-size:19px}.specs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin:28px 0}.method-note{color:#6e7680;font-size:14px;max-width:520px;margin-bottom:22px;padding-left:14px;border-left:2px solid rgba(25,217,255,.4)}.spec{border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);padding:15px}.spec strong{display:block;font-family:var(--heading);color:#fff;font-size:13px}.spec small{color:#737b84}

.timeline{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px}.event{padding:20px;border-left:2px solid var(--red);background:#08090d;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-right:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);transition:.3s}.event:hover{border-left-color:var(--cyan);transform:translateY(-4px)}.event img{width:46px;height:46px;display:block;margin-bottom:12px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(212,8,47,.25))}.event time{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:9px;color:var(--red2);letter-spacing:2px}.event h3{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:15px;margin:10px 0}.event p{font-size:14px;color:#818994}

.poll-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.75fr 1.25fr;gap:45px;align-items:start}.poll-info h2{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:36px;line-height:1.05}.poll-info p{color:#9198a1;margin-top:15px}.poll-callout{margin-top:22px;padding:16px 18px;border:1px solid rgba(212,8,47,.3);background:rgba(212,8,47,.06);font-size:14px;color:#d2d7dd}.poll-callout b{color:var(--red2);font-family:var(--heading);font-size:18px}.poll{background:#08080c;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:28px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.poll h3{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:17px;color:#fff;margin-bottom:22px}.option{width:100%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);background:#0c0d12;color:#dbe1e6;padding:16px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;margin:7px 0;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.option:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:var(--w,0%);background:rgba(212,8,47,.13);transition:.5s}.option span{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px}.option:hover{border-color:var(--red)}.option strong{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:10px}.total{font-size:12px;color:#68717b;margin-top:14px}

.community{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}.submit{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0a0a0f,#0d1217);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:25px}.form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}.field.full{grid-column:1/-1}label{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#737b84}input,textarea,select{width:100%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);background:#050508;color:#fff;padding:13px 14px;outline:none;border-radius:0}input:focus,textarea:focus,select:focus{border-color:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(25,217,255,.07)}textarea{min-height:135px;resize:vertical}
.feed{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#08090d;padding:25px}.feed-item{padding:17px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.feed-item:last-child{border-bottom:0}.feed-item b{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:11px;color:#fff}.feed-item p{color:#838b95;font-size:15px;margin-top:5px}

.footer{padding:55px 0 30px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:#020204}.footer-grid{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;align-items:center}.footer-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}.footer-brand img{width:58px;height:58px;object-fit:contain}.footer p{color:#666d75;font-size:14px}.status{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:8px;color:#6e7882;letter-spacing:1px}.status i{display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#28e07b;margin-right:6px;box-shadow:0 0 9px #28e07b}

.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.80);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);display:none;place-items:center;padding:20px;z-index:2000}.modal.open{display:grid}.modal-box{width:min(760px,100%);max-height:88vh;overflow:auto;background:#09090d;border:1px solid rgba(212,8,47,.5);box-shadow:0 35px 120px #000;padding:30px;position:relative}.close{position:absolute;right:15px;top:8px;background:none;border:0;color:#777;font-size:28px;cursor:pointer}.modal-box .case-code{font-family:var(--heading);color:var(--red2);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:3px}.modal-box h3{font-family:var(--heading);font-size:28px;color:#fff;margin:8px 0 15px}.modal-box p{color:#a0a7af}.modal-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:20px}.modal-meta div{padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13px}.modal-meta b{display:block;font-family:var(--heading);font-size:8px;color:#6e7680;margin-bottom:4px}
#stars{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:-1}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media(max-width:1050px){.links{display:none}.menu{display:block}.yt{display:none}.archive{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.categories{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.timeline{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.feature-grid,.poll-wrap,.community{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{min-height:720px}.hero-art{opacity:.4;right:-18%}.section-head{display:block}.section-head p{margin-top:12px}}
@media(max-width:620px){.container{width:min(100% - 26px,1200px)}.hero{padding-top:105px;min-height:670px}.hero h1{font-size:43px}.hero p{font-size:19px}.archive,.categories,.timeline{grid-template-columns:1fr}.form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.field.full{grid-column:auto}.specs{grid-template-columns:1fr}.footer-grid{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}.nav{height:70px}.brand img{width:44px;height:44px}.brand strong{font-size:15px}.hero-art{width:650px;right:-80%;top:20%}.feature{padding:65px 0}.modal-meta{grid-template-columns:1fr}.poll{padding:20px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.ticker-track,.scan,.reveal{animation:none;transition:none}.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}}

var(--heading);line-height:1.05;color:#fff}.module-body p{color:#858e98;font-size:15px;margin:8px 0 14px}.chips{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}.chip{padding:5px 7px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11);font:8px var(--heading);color:#aeb7c0}.mini-facts{display:flex;gap:14px;margin:4px 0 14px;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid <div class="modal" id="caseModal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="modalTitle">
<div class="modal-box"><button class="close" onclick="closeCase()" aria-label="Cerrar">×</button><div class="case-code" id="modalCode"></div><h3 id="modalTitle"></h3><p id="modalDesc"></p><div class="modal-meta"><div><b>DATOS</b><span id="m1"></span></div><div><b>HIPÓTESIS</b><span id="m2"></span></div><div><b>ESTADO</b><span id="m3"></span></div></div></div>
</div>

<script>
const modal=document.getElementById('caseModal');
function openCase(code,title,desc,m1,m2,m3){document.getElementById('modalCode').textContent=code;document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent=title;document.getElementById('modalDesc').textContent=desc;document.getElementById('m1').textContent=m1;document.getElementById('m2').textContent=m2;document.getElementById('m3').textContent=m3;modal.classList.add('open');document.body.style.overflow='hidden'}
function closeCase(){modal.classList.remove('open');document.body.style.overflow=''}
modal.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===modal)closeCase()});document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeCase()});

function vote(btn){const options=[...document.querySelectorAll('.option')];options.forEach(o=>o.style.setProperty('--w',o.querySelector('b').textContent));btn.style.borderColor='var(--cyan)';btn.querySelector('b').textContent='VOTADO';}
function submitCase(e){e.preventDefault();const name=document.getElementById('name').value.trim()||'ANÓNIMO';alert('Expediente recibido, '+name+'. En esta versión demo el formulario no envía datos a un servidor.');e.target.reset();}

const menu=document.querySelector('.menu'),navLinks=document.querySelector('.links');
menu.addEventListener('click',()=>{const open=navLinks.classList.toggle('mobile-open');menu.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open)});
document.querySelectorAll('.links a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>navLinks.classList.remove('mobile-open')));
const style=document.createElement('style');style.textContent='.links.mobile-open{display:flex;position:absolute;top:70px;left:0;right:0;padding:18px 20px;background:rgba(2,2,5,.97);flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(212,8,47,.25)}.links.mobile-open a{padding:7px 0}';document.head.appendChild(style);

const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('visible')}),{threshold:.12});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>observer.observe(el));

const canvas=document.getElementById('stars'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');let stars=[];
function resize(){canvas.width=innerWidth;canvas.height=innerHeight;stars=Array.from({length:Math.min(180,Math.floor(innerWidth/7))},()=>({x:Math.random()*canvas.width,y:Math.random()*canvas.height,r:Math.random()*1.2+.2,a:Math.random()*.55+.1,s:Math.random()*.18+.03}))}
function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);for(const s of stars){s.y+=s.s;if(s.y>canvas.height)s.y=0;ctx.globalAlpha=s.a;ctx.fillStyle='#dce9f4';ctx.fillRect(s.x,s.y,s.r,s.r)}requestAnimationFrame(draw)}
addEventListener('resize',resize);resize();draw();

const sections=[...document.querySelectorAll('main section[id]')],links=[...document.querySelectorAll('.links a')];
const activeObs=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){links.forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle('active',a.getAttribute('href')==='#'+e.target.id))}}),{rootMargin:'-35% 0px -55% 0px'});
sections.forEach(s=>activeObs.observe(s));


/* Command-center search/filter system */
const caseSearch=document.getElementById('caseSearch');
const filterButtons=[...document.querySelectorAll('#filters .filter-btn')];
const archiveCards=[...document.querySelectorAll('#expedientes .archive .card')];
const noResults=document.getElementById('noResults');
let activeFilter='all';
function filterArchive(){
 const q=(caseSearch?.value||'').trim().toLowerCase(); let shown=0;
 archiveCards.forEach(card=>{const text=card.innerText.toLowerCase();const cat=card.dataset.cat||'';const okCat=activeFilter==='all'||cat===activeFilter;const okText=!q||text.includes(q);const show=okCat&&okText;card.style.display=show?'block':'none';if(show)shown++});
 if(noResults) noResults.classList.toggle('show',shown===0);
}
caseSearch?.addEventListener('input',filterArchive);
filterButtons.forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{activeFilter=btn.dataset.filter;filterButtons.forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b===btn));filterArchive();document.getElementById('expedientes')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'})}));

function showToast(msg){let t=document.getElementById('ztxToast');if(!t){t=document.createElement('div');t.id='ztxToast';t.style.cssText='position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:20px;z-index:3000;max-width:360px;background:#090b10;border:1px solid rgba(25,217,255,.45);box-shadow:0 20px 70px #000;padding:15px 17px;color:#dfe6eb;font:12px var(--body);transform:translateY(20px);opacity:0;transition:.25s';document.body.appendChild(t)}t.textContent=msg;t.style.opacity='1';t.style.transform='translateY(0)';clearTimeout(window.__toast);window.__toast=setTimeout(()=>{t.style.opacity='0';t.style.transform='translateY(20px)'},3500)}

/* Subtle cursor/parallax interaction for premium cards */
document.querySelectorAll('.module,.case,.card,.category').forEach(el=>{el.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();const x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5,y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;el.style.transform=`perspective(900px) rotateX(${(-y*2.2).toFixed(2)}deg) rotateY(${(x*2.2).toFixed(2)}deg) translateY(-3px)`});el.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{el.style.transform=''})});
</script>
<script>
/* El emblema oficial es la X roja; se define aquí para no alterar el código fuente base. */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const brandLogo = document.querySelector('.brand img');
  if (brandLogo) {
    brandLogo.src = 'assets/DT-820WS_400x400.jpg';
    brandLogo.alt = 'Logotipo oficial ZentauriX: X roja';
  }
});
</script>
